_comment: The smallest config that works for anyone with an Anthropic API key.
Copy to local/config.json (git-ignored) or point --config at it, then:
jichi doctor        # confirms the key, the endpoint and the roles
No key in this file, ever: apiKeyEnv names the VARIABLE jichi reads.
promptCache is ON by default for this provider and is the reason to
prefer it for long sessions: jichi places cache_control breakpoints on
the system+tools prefix and on the conversation tail, and the TUI token
line shows cached=N so you can see it working (docs/PROMPT_CACHING.md).
Verify rather than assume -- `jichi telemetry` reports the per-model hit
rate, because a backend that ACCEPTS a caching request and returns no
cached tokens looks identical to one that caches (measured; see
Anthropic serves no embeddings endpoint, so there is no embed role here
and retrieval tools stay unregistered. Add a second model pointing at
any OpenAI-compatible embedding server to turn them on -- see
